title: "Notation"

# Notation

The following notation is used consistently throughout the course.

## Forces and Moments

- \(N\): axial force
- \(V\): shear force
- \(M\): bending moment
- \(T\): torque

## Stresses and Strains

- \(\sigma\): normal stress
- \(\tau\): shear stress
- \(\varepsilon\): normal strain
- \(\gamma\): shear strain

## Material Properties

- \(E\): Young's modulus
- \(G\): shear modulus

## Cross-Section Properties

- \(A\): cross-sectional area
- \(I\): second moment of area
- \(J\): polar moment of inertia
- \(Q\): first moment of area

## Displacements

- \(u\): axial displacement
- \(w\): transverse displacement
- \(\theta\): rotation

## Buckling

- \(P_{cr}\): critical buckling load
- \(L\): column length
- \(K\): effective length factor

## Coordinate System

For beams:

- \(x\): beam axis
- \(y, z\): cross-section coordinates
